assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: environment-only background layer for a 2D pixel-art game cutscene. Edit/recompose the environment from the supplied game art references into one entirely UNPOPULATED wide 16:9 background, around 1672x941. Reference 1 is the game's Battle background and controls the coarse crisp pixel geometry, limited colors and blocky scenery. Reference 2 is the laboratory atmosphere; reference 3 is a previous scene only for environmental continuity. Every human and character present in any reference must be removed and must NOT be copied. IMPORTANT OUTPUT CONTAINS ZERO PEOPLE, characters, human silhouettes, figures in glass tanks, faces, faces on screens, dolls, animal toys, animals, character statues, hologram figures, portraits, reflection people, cartoon symbols of faces or bunny logos. No words, letters, digits, subtitles, speech bubbles, dialogue panels, user interface, watermark or signature. All screens are blank dark glass or simple soft cyan reflections, no data/interface graphics. Premium retro RPG pixel-art background: chunky visible square pixels, hard stair-step edges, clean large geometric clusters, limited dark navy/teal/magenta palette, slight blocky dithering, no smooth painted gradients, no photorealism, no vector outlines, no blur, no 3D. This is a background-only layer: separate small chibi sprites will be rendered in front by Unity. Preserve a broad unobstructed staging area in the center-left and middle foreground (approximately x=12..65%, y=35..85%), with readable ground or floor for separate characters. Keep the top 15 percent and the lower-right 35 percent visually quiet enough for separate text overlays, but do not draw any overlays. Keep foreground props outside the main character staging area. Full-bleed opaque environment; no transparent cutouts, no panels. Do not reproduce the prior full-scene character artwork. Specific scene: An empty Aglaia laboratory at night, dark navy structural walls, a few large cyan glass experiment cylinders containing ONLY CLEAR FLUID and bubbles with NOTHING alive inside, magenta door lighting, a black inactive PC monitor and tidy keyboard at a workstation near the back-left, laboratory bench and vials in the background, an unoccupied plain black-and-magenta gaming chair near the back-left workstation with no logos. A broad reflective tiled floor fills the center-left and foreground, ready for separately drawn Nia and researcher Hana. Wide side-on story staging, cool night lighting, empty windows overlook the distant island.
